title: Quotas
caption: Quota posture: {scope}
loadingDescription: Loading quota posture and usage overview.
blockedDescription: Select an organization to view quota posture.
emptyDescription: No quotas have been published for this organization.
noAccessDescription: You do not have permission to view quotas for this context.
notFoundDescription: The organization or workspace was not found.
networkDescription: Could not load quota posture. Check your connection and retry.
adjustDescription: Change this dimension’s limit by editing the plan assigned to the active organization.
resolving: Resolving the plan assigned to the organization…
planErrorDescription: Could not resolve the plan assigned to the organization.
planWideTitle: This change affects the entire plan, including other organizations.
planWideDescription: You are editing the limit for {dimension} in plan “{plan}”; it applies to every organization using that plan.
invalid: Enter an integer greater than or equal to -1 (use -1 for unlimited).
invalidServer: INVALID_LIMIT_VALUE: use -1 for unlimited, 0 or a positive integer.
frozenServer: PLAN_LIMITS_FROZEN: this plan no longer accepts limit changes.
noPlan: This organization has no assigned plan, so there is no plan limit to adjust for {dimension}. Assign a plan to the organization to define its quota limits.
frozen: Plan “{plan}” assigned to this organization is retired and no longer accepts limit changes. Change the plan status or assign another active plan to adjust {dimension}.
savedDescription: {dimension} is now {value} in plan “{plan}”. Close this panel to see the updated quota table.
confirmDescription: Confirm limit {value} for {dimension} in plan “{plan}”. It applies to every organization using that plan.
